summary.text: Jared Sullivan is a Democratic member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Grafton 2 who has held the seat since December 7, 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A business owner and real estate economist, he succeeded Timothy Egan (D) in the seat.

paragraphs.text: Jared Sullivan earned bachelor's and master's degrees from Montana State University.
His career experience includes founding a real estate consulting and development firm and working as a real estate economist.
In the 2023-2024 session, Sullivan was assigned to the Commerce and Consumer Affairs Committee.
